units.source_text: 我愣了一下神，一刹那纹丝不动。

en.t: For a moment I was stunned, and for an instant I did not move at all.

units.source_text: 河童好像也很惊讶似的，连平支在前额上遮阳光的手都没动一下。

en.t: The kappa seemed just as startled, and even the hand it held flat before its forehead to shade its eyes did not move.

units.source_text: 不久，我一跃而起，扑向站到岩石上了河童。

en.t: Before long I sprang up and lunged at the kappa standing on the rock.
At the same moment, the kappa dodged aside.

units.source_text: 或者说，它是逃跑了，因为他身子一闪就消失的无影无踪了。

en.t: Or rather, it fled, because with one quick flick of its body it vanished without a trace.

units.source_text: 我更加惊讶了，私下观察周围的竹林。

en.t: I was even more astonished and quietly looked around the surrounding bamboo grove.

units.source_text: 原来河童并未消失，而是做出一副随时要逃走的样子，在离我两三米的地方盯着我呢。

en.t: It turned out that the kappa had not disappeared at all, but was watching me from two or three meters away, poised as if ready to flee at any moment.

units.source_text: 其实这倒不让我惊讶，我惊讶的是河童身上的颜色。

en.t: In fact, that was not what surprised me; what surprised me was the color of the kappa's body.

units.source_text: 之前在岩石上看着我的时候河童身上是灰色的，现在却变成绿色了。

en.t: When it had been watching me from the rock earlier, the kappa's body had been gray, but now it had turned green.

units.source_text: 我大喊一声：“畜生！”再一次向它扑去。

en.t: I shouted, "Damn it!" and lunged at it once more.
Without a doubt, the kappa ran away again.

units.source_text: 就这样，我穿过竹林，越过岩石，玩命的追了它约莫半个小时。

en.t: In this way, I chased it desperately for about half an hour, running through the bamboo grove and over the rocks.
